$commentWinBonusShare: P2-09 (DEF-10, ECO-08, 2026-11-18): winBonusShare per league, a share of the Keep's lowest generated raid loot (Coins and Provisions), larger of it and winBonus, x stars/3. Fitted to the regular campaign: 6.8-18.7% of an average raid's banked loot at Keeps 5-15 (Obsidian, Ember and Storm 0.095 after the Phase 2 campaign put Keep 15 at 22.6% with 0.115; Shadow 0.13 -> 0.11 after Phase 3 put the regular Keep 15 in Shadow at 20.2%) (was 22% at Keep 5 falling to 0.7% at Keep 15). Iron's flat winBonus 5000 -> 4000 each so Keep 5 stays under 20%.

matchmaking.$commentLossStreak: P2-10 (DEF-12, 2026-11-18): each consecutive lost raid (0 stars, at least minDeployShare of the army's housing deployed) lowers the earned-strength floor by perLoss, up to max; a win resets it. Device matchmaking only (the server's generated fallback keeps its own, lower floor).
matchmaking.$commentLayouts: P4-07 (CMB-08, 2026-11-18, SIM_RULES 8): from fromKeep, a rival clan's outposts use one of its home layouts (picked by the seed) with that layout's level-bias offset, so the easiest and hardest layout differ by 15 points or less with the raid bots' mix (measured over 20 battles a layout: through opponentForRank, clan bias and home tempers included: Keep 8 49.0-60.8, Keep 12 45.6-59.0, Keep 15 57.4-64.5 (gaps 11.8 / 13.4 / 7.2); one ring generator before, and the five layouts differed by 35 / 23 / 16 at level bias 0.5).

rating.$comment: Hidden ratings for matchmaking (roadmap Phase 3, src/gameplay/sim/rating.ts). Attack Rating (AR) is an attacker's skill, Base Rating (BR) how hard a base is to raid. Honor stays the visible ladder.
